- Tue Mar 17, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Mar 18, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Mar 19, 09:00–10:30

Draft agenda (attached ACME_prelim_agenda.md):
1) Introductions & goals (5m)
2) Deployment models: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem (20m)
3) Network architecture & connectivity options (VPN, DirectConnect, VPC peering) (25m)
4) IAM, SSO, KMS/HSM integration patterns and audit logs (20m)
5) Action items & timeline (20m)

Could you confirm the best time and forward to any internal engineers or procurement who should join? We can also split into two shorter sessions if that makes it easier for your team.

Attachments: ACME_prelim_agenda.md; please let me know if you'd like a different focus.
